claims.statement: The implementation exposes fixed Delivery, Review, pre-merge, closeout-readonly, and recheck profiles without user-provided repository, API, gh, Git, shell, output-path, or working-directory arguments.
Unknown gates, missing permissions, rate limits, endpoint failures, and bounded evidence truncation return partial rather than pass.
The runner suppresses workflow_evidence git fetch, uses fixed read-only Git inspection and ls-remote calls, and leaves Git/GitHub writes approval gated.
A consuming workflow stage can replace a sequence of model-visible GitHub/Git fact queries with one fixed runner invocation while retaining internal operation counts and structured evidence.
Task #84 does not establish a Token reduction percentage or Task #65 candidate advantage.

model_visible_invocations_after.scope: one fixed evidence profile invocation per stage

legacy_model_visible_git_gh_commands.scope: requires an external historical rollout count

github_api_calls_per_profile.scope: reported by each result under evidence.operations.github_queries

guardian_turns.scope: requires a fresh live Codex Rules probe

compact_stdout_bytes.scope: record during Task #84 live Delivery probe

token_optimization_article: compact output and external evidence separation

limitations: No live Task #84 PR probe is included before a PR and committed head exist.
No Task #65 candidate or Token reduction claim is made.
Task #85 is responsible for changing workflow Skills to consume the fixed runner.
